avis.texte: I have tried several other retinols, including one of those mail order ones where a dermatologist supposedly customizes a formula for you and I could never get past the dry, flaky, red stage. I assumed retinol was not for me. When this came out promising to work for sensitive skin I was like we'll see about that! Well, I have had NO issues with Cocokind! I am up to using it every other night. I'm not sure I see a lot of impact on my face, but hopefully it's doing some good behind the scenes.

This is my first retinol I have ever tried. I can say that I absolutely love it! The difference I see in my face when I wake up in the mornings is amazing and I have noticed my acne has decreased a lot! Definitely would recommend this product.

Iv never used a product like this before due to my eczema! Did some research and found this product. I did a patch test and no reaction!!!!! It has definitely helped my skin look smoother and reduce the redness

this is the first time in my adult life that I haven't had chin acne! I'm so grateful for all cocokind products, but this one especially keeps the whiteheads and cystic acne at bay. I'm thrilled! this retinol has also helped reduce the look of sebaceous filaments on my nose. I left town for a bit, didn't bring it (the packaging isn't travel friendly - only gripe!), and totally missed it while I was gone. I love how you took customer feedback into account for the Eye Cream packaging. I would suggest a more travel friendly option for this? it goes crunch too easily. otherwise, sold!

The only retinol I've been able to use on my neck. My neck and chest are pretty sensitive and although I've tried several different retinol products of different strengths _ all of them led to irritation and barrier damage. But this one finally works! I curse a small amount, as usual, and I'm seeing great results with no irritation.
